scope: Read-only source review of the isolated fork-rebind-root-port checkpoint; no runtime qualification claimed

findings.contract: Serialize conflicting publications and fence stale generations
findings.evidence: read_record calls host.read with no pinned generation. Phase two validates the current seed, then resolves a generation and applies the replacement against that later generation. An intervening owner can advance the seed between validation and resolve; CAS on the later generation does not validate the earlier seed observation.
findings.required_verification: Pin record reads and writes to one generation; deterministically interleave two owners and prove an earlier transition cannot overwrite a later transition. Cover intent admission as well as seed replacement.

findings.contract: Corrupt and missing durable content have distinct explicit outcomes
findings.evidence: The new published_seed lookup uses if let Ok, discarding errors before continuing publication. Corrupt or inaccessible durable state must not be treated as an absent publication.
findings.required_verification: Handle only the typed absence outcome as absence; preserve corruption and storage errors, with negative tests proving no subsequent publication.

actions: Both findings sent to the fork owner. Checkpoint remains outside the root branch pending repair and production fault verification.
